To make a query, output \texttt{? Y} where $1 \le Y \le N$. The judge will respond with:
\begin{itemize}
\item \texttt{>} if the hidden number is greater than $Y$;
\item \texttt{<} if the hidden number is less than $Y$;
\item \texttt{=} if the hidden number is equal to $Y$.
\end{itemize}
When you know the answer, output \texttt{! Y} and terminate.
